basis: No ArtCraft notes app exists. Spec models Microsoft OneNote (Microsoft 365, Windows desktop, current channel 2025-2026; merges OneNote 2016 ribbon with features ported from OneNote for Windows 10). Every control is source "office". sourceRef uses "office:OneNote/<Tab> > <Group> > <Control>" because there is no Rust file to cite; command sourceRef names the planned Arkemis module.

conventions.items: split/dropdown/gallery/color controls carry their menu entries in "items" (same shape as a control)
conventions.args: optional "args" = fixed arguments the control passes to its command
conventions.presentation: dialogs may set presentation: pane|backstage|inline-bar|full-window (default modal)
